{{Quote|All right, Solo, in addition to the crystal, I offer this ''holo-map'', which contains the star coordinates&hellip; for the ''Seoul 5 system''.|[[Unidentified Imperial scout|An Imperial scout]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="SW84" />}}
